what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Moldova, as counted by UNHCR and recorded by IDMC.
UNHCR's last figure for IDPs of concern in Moldova is 1000, for 2002.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Moldova in these years, so it does not say why people were displaced.
IDMC's disaster records for Moldova list storms and wildfires.

when.text: UNHCR's figures rose from 1278 in 1997 to 8080 in 1999, then fell.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1999 and 2000.

how.text: In 2024, IDMC recorded 166 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Moldova.
